interpretation: The public archive identity, all LevelPacks inputs and the complete fan replay result are verified against build 83. The full build 83 package replay audit confirms 2,399 winning routes, 3,600 levels without a matching candidate, 21 failed replay levels and no load/decode/render failures. The strict route gate remains open for 3,621 levels. The slim NeoLemmix archive also has a direct resource audit. The build 83 L2 app payload was staged from the exact archive extraction using the 218 files in the release input manifest; all files match by path, size and SHA-256. The L2 route, carry-over, chain and event gates passed against this payload. The archive extraction contained 14 original DOS interpreter/support files that the app packager excludes. L2 ark and source-behaviour gaps remain open. L3 source behaviour, campaign, ending and carried-route gaps remain open until their own evidence passes.
